name: Rohan Moreau
headline: Backend Engineer
summary: Software engineer who has built customer-facing and internal systems across web application and API teams. Comfortable working across full-stack delivery, service structure, and data-heavy features in fast-moving product groups. Known for improving reliability, tightening implementation details, and collaborating closely with product and design partners.
